scoring_matrix.formula: QQQ close / SMA50 - 1
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Captures AI/growth-sensitive benchmark; use split-adjusted close.

scoring_matrix.formula: SPY close / SMA200 - 1
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Long-term broad-market context.

scoring_matrix.formula: QQQ close / close 5 completed sessions earlier - 1
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Short-term direction, not forecast.

scoring_matrix.formula: RSP 21-session price return minus SPY 21-session price return
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Equal-weight relative leadership; separately inspect absolute breadth.

scoring_matrix.formula: Percent of point-in-time S&P 500 constituents above own SMA50
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Constituent count and coverage must accompany value.

scoring_matrix.formula: Percent of point-in-time S&P 500 constituents above own SMA200
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Use same membership basis for historical comparisons.

scoring_matrix.formula: 100 * sum(new 52-week highs - lows over 5 sessions) / sum(eligible listings over same sessions)
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Common-stock-only NYSE+Nasdaq universe; exclude funds, preferreds and duplicate listings.

scoring_matrix.formula: Broad USD high-yield option-adjusted spread
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Actual spread series preferred; HYG price is not a spread.

scoring_matrix.formula: HY OAS latest minus 5 publication observations earlier
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Store reference-date lag; never label daily OAS intraday.

scoring_matrix.formula: Investment-grade OAS latest minus 5 publication observations earlier
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Independent confirmation across credit quality.

scoring_matrix.formula: 10-year TIPS real yield change over 21 observations
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Falling real yields score supportive only absent growth-shock override.

scoring_matrix.formula: 10-year Treasury yield change over 5 observations
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Yield direction is conditional; falling yield does not prove risk-on.

scoring_matrix.formula: 5-year breakeven inflation change over 21 observations
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Inflation compensation proxy, not a pure inflation forecast.

scoring_matrix.formula: Dollar index return over 5 sessions
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Use one consistent DXY series; do not mix with WSJ dollar index.

scoring_matrix.formula: Robust z-score of SOFR minus IORB using prior 252 available observations
scoring_matrix.interpretation: robust_z=(latest - trailing median)/(1.4826*MAD); no zero MAD fallback; missing if undefined. Lag baseline one observation.

scoring_matrix.formula: Reserve balances change over 4 weekly observations divided by earlier balance
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Keep TGA and ON RRP as explanatory context; avoid counting a net-liquidity identity as independent confirmation.

scoring_matrix.formula: WTI futures return over 5 sessions
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Use documented roll-adjusted series. Falling oil is not supportive during growth shock.

scoring_matrix.formula: ULSD futures return over 21 sessions
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Use documented roll-adjusted series; tracks transport cost pressure separately from crude.

scoring_matrix.formula: VIX close
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Very low VIX earns supportive score but separately flags complacency.

scoring_matrix.formula: VIX / VIX3M
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Same timestamp for both inputs; backwardation flags stress.

scoring_matrix.formula: Percentile of 5-day mean equity-only put/call ratio against preceding 252 observations
scoring_matrix.interpretation: Score by bins [-1,0,1,-1,-2]. Low percentile flags crowding; extreme high percentile flags fear, not automatic buy.

principles: Separate observed conditions, changes, narratives and hypotheses.
No conversion of scores to rally probabilities or automatic orders.
Preserve timestamps, source identity, revisions and missing values.
Measure current level and recent impulse separately.
Use actual credit spreads; ETF price ratios are context only.
All thresholds and weights are proposed policy choices requiring point-in-time validation.
